"""감사로그·체결로그 요약(건수만). 읽기 전용."""
import csv
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/home/gram/korea-quant-system")
rows = list(csv.DictReader((REPO / "data/bot_candidate_audit.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="")))
by = OrderedDict()
for r in rows:
    k = (r["AsOf"], r["ConfigFingerprint"][:16])
    d = by.setdefault(k, Counter())
    d["rows"] += 1
    d[f"sel={r['SelectionOutcome']}"] += 1
    d[f"sig={r['SignalType']}"] += 1
for (asof, fp), c in by.items():
    print(asof, fp, dict(c))
print("audit rows total", len(rows), "| distinct AsOf", len({r["AsOf"] for r in rows}))
p = REPO / "data/bot_trade_log.csv"
if p.exists():
    t = list(csv.DictReader(p.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="")))
    cols = t[0].keys() if t else []
    ev = Counter(r.get("Event") or r.get("EventType") or r.get("Status") or "?" for r in t)
    print("trade log rows", len(t), "| columns:", ", ".join(cols)[:200])
    print("trade log events", dict(ev))
